unit: paired delta in test ROC-AUC (tmqm init minus random init)
why: BLK-PA4 fix step 1: the tmQM-pretrain A/B was Ru-only (5 seeds). Extend to a second metal and report per-metal paired deltas with a Holm-Bonferroni family correction.
protocol: per metal: MetalCytoToxDB subset; FIXED Bemis-Murcko scaffold split (BLK-PA12); seeds vary model init only; the ONLY difference between arms is init: tmqm|random

paired_delta.ci_method: t-based 95% CI (t_{.975,4}=2.776); percentile bootstrap (20000 resamples, seed 0) is reported as reference only and is anti-conservative at n=5
t-based 95% CI (t_{.975,4}=2.776); percentile bootstrap (20000 resamples, seed 0) is reported as reference only and is anti-conservative at n=5

significance_note: The family correction uses the paired one-sided t-test on the 5 per-seed deltas, not the percentile bootstrap. At n=5 the bootstrap is anti-conservative: on the Ir arm it returns p=0.0120 while the t-test returns 0.0680 and Wilcoxon 0.1562 on the identical deltas, because 5 points cannot generate enough distinct resamples. The bootstrap CI is kept in each arm as *_reference_only.

honest_negative.claim_2_status: Metal-specific, not general. On the fixed scaffold split the tmQM-init benefit is positive only where it is Holm-significant (see family_verdict) and null elsewhere; it must not be written as a blanket 'pretraining transfers'.
honest_negative.ir_is_suggestive_not_confirmed: Ir's point estimate is +0.0486 but only 3/5 seeds are positive and the t-based 95% CI includes zero, so Ir is reported as a suggestive benefit, not a confirmed one.
honest_negative.ru_reference: the Ru single-metal record (with its supersedes history) lives in metrics/by_metric/tmqm_pretrain_init_ab_ru.json; not duplicated here (AGENTS.md §5.5)
honest_negative.do_not_claim: that a result on Ru+Ir generalises to all five metals — only the two tested are covered
